"Horticulture Digital Marketplace and Social Media Campaign: To draw the attention of key horticulture stakeholders to the sector and drive its membership base, HBP engages in social media campaigns to improve its visibility, market access, and operational efficiency for the horticulture sector in Ghana. The Horticulture Business Platform (HBP) was designed to serve as a comprehensive hub for members of Ghana’s horticulture value chain. To promote value preposition for its members, IDH and HBP initiated a digital marketplace platform development app with a digital service provider called Agrocenta Digital Solutions. The platform is a digital platform that has key members of the sector on one platform for networking and for producers and off-takers to interact on demand and supply businesses. The HBP digital marketplace platform was developed to enable members of the horticulture value chain in Ghana to: - Connect and network with other stakeholders. - Trade products and services within the horticulture sector. - Access business support services offered on the platform. Thus, the platform allows businesses, and service providers to register, create profiles, and interact within a secured and structured business environment. Through a streamlined registration process, users can present their products, services, and business details to a wider network, fostering collaboration and growth opportunities within the sector. The core features of HBP digital marketplace enables its users to list horticultural products and services for sale. Buyers can browse listings, users of the app can filter by categories, and directly engage with sellers through the platform. This digital marketplace reduces barriers to market entry, enhances product visibility, and helps users secure new business opportunities without relying on traditional middlemen or physical trade fairs. The platform has features such as marketplace, business directory, messaging, e-library, admin dashboard, security features and many more."
